About us

I.J. Projects is a family-founded building and project management company with over 50 years of industry experience, delivering high-quality building, civil construction and project management services across South Australia. The company specialises in managing commercial, government and infrastructure projects from planning through to successful completion and has established a strong reputation for quality, safety and client satisfaction


About the role

As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the company's sales, business development and marketing functions. This is a newly established full-time permanent management position reporting directly to senior management and will play a key role in driving business growth, strengthening the company's market presence, and developing long-term relationships with government, commercial and institutional clients


Key responsibilities:

- Develop and implement the company's sales and marketing strategies to achieve sustainable business growth and increase market share.
- Identify new business opportunities, analyse market trends and competitor activities, and develop strategic growth initiatives.
- Lead the company's business development activities by establishing and maintaining relationships with government agencies, developers, consultants, contractors and key industry stakeholders.
- Oversee the preparation of marketing strategies, promotional campaigns and brand positioning to enhance the company's profile within the construction and project management sectors.
- Direct the development and implementation of client relationship management strategies to strengthen customer retention and generate repeat business.
- Work closely with senior management to identify and pursue major project opportunities, including government and private sector procurement and tender opportunities.
- Prepare sales forecasts, marketing budgets, business performance reports and strategic recommendations for senior management.
- Lead, mentor and manage sales and marketing personnel to achieve business objectives and maintain high performance standards.
- Represent the company at industry events, networking functions and stakeholder meetings to promote the company's services and establish strategic partnerships.


Selection criteria:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Management, Commerce or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a senior sales and marketing management role with responsibility for developing and implementing strategic business growth initiatives.
- Proven ability to develop commercial opportunities and build strong relationships with government agencies, commercial clients, developers and key industry stakeholders.
- Strong strategic planning, leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience preparing sales forecasts, marketing plans and business performance reports.
- Previous experience within the building, construction, engineering or project management industry will be highly regarded; applicants with transferable senior sales and marketing management experience from other industries are also encouraged to apply.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly skilled Database Developer to join a forward-thinking educational institution in Perth.   This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across SQL Server, integrations, reporting, and application development, with the opportunity to have a real impact on how data is used across the business.  
      This role sits at the heart of the Information and Learning Technologies team, where your technical expertise will directly support both business and academic operations. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions and digital applications that underpin the organisation's strategic goals. This position offers you the chance to work closely with stakeholders across the school community, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable technology outcomes. The role is perfect for someone who thrives in a supportive environment that values knowledge sharing, professional growth, and making a tangible impact on student wellbeing 
 
 Play a key role in shaping data-driven decision-making by developing integrated solutions that enhance accessibility, reporting, and analytics across the institution. 
 Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a collaborative team that values professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 Make a real difference by supporting student wellbeing and academic success through innovative use of technology and data intelligence. 
 
     
  Responsibilities:  
     
 
 Serve as the primary system administrator and subject-matter expert for the key projects, overseeing configuration, user management, data integrity, version upgrades, and module administration. 
 Design, maintain, and optimise database schemas and SQL Server infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability, security, and data quality across all systems. 
 Architect, develop, and manage integrations between core CRM platforms, finance systems, cloud identity providers, and communication tools using APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, and ETL processes. 
 Develop dashboards, reports, self-service analytics tools, and custom queries using platforms like Power BI, Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar to support strategic planning and operational needs. 
 Champion data quality frameworks by implementing profiling, cleansing, validation routines, and advising stakeholders on evidence-based decision-making. 
 Administer database change management processes including updates, release procedures, backup/recovery strategies while ensuring compliance with privacy legislation and organisational policies. 
 Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain custom web applications or internal tools using modern frameworks (Python/.NET/Node.js) aligned with the institution's technology stack. 
 Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments to gather requirements for digital solutions that extend enterprise system capabilities while ensuring secure coding practices are followed. 
 Create comprehensive technical documentation in partnership with key stakeholders; utilise ticketing systems for request tracking; document all changes thoroughly before implementation. 
 
 Mentor IT staff in best practices for database management and application development while staying abreast of emerging technologies. 
 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related discipline is essential for this role. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server technologies including T-SQL scripting, query optimisation techniques as well as experience with SSIS/SSRS or equivalent reporting tools is required. 
 Demonstrated ability to design API-based or middleware integrations (REST/SOAP/webhooks/ETL/Wonde) along with strong skills in ASP.NET/PowerShell/scripting languages is necessary. 
 Solid application development experience using one or more programming languages such as Python/C#/.NET/Node.js/PHP is expected. 
 Proven track record delivering business intelligence solutions using Power BI/Tableau/SSRS/Microsoft Fabric/Crystal Reports or similar platforms is highly valued. 
 Comprehensive understanding of data governance principles including privacy legislation (Australian Privacy Act/APP) plus information security best practices is mandatory. 
 Minimum five years experience in senior database administration or application development roles ideally within education or enterprise environments is preferred. 
 Excellent business analysis skills encompassing risk assessment solution design capabilities coupled with outstanding troubleshooting/problem-solving abilities are vital. 
 Exceptional communication skills enabling clear translation of technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders alongside proven stakeholder engagement experience are important attributes. 
 A positive outlook combined with willingness to embrace organisational values around service/integrity/stewardship plus demonstrated commitment to health & safety policies is expected. 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply.  
 To apply please click apply or call  Milena Wawrzyniak-Kalyanpur on +61 8 9266 0980 for a confidential discussion.

Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.


We are looking for candidates with the following attributes and experience:

· University graduated, with coursework around software development, computer networks, and web development.

· Two or more years of professional work experience with Workforce and/or Customer Identity related products such as NetIQ, Silverfort, Ping Identity, and Microsoft Entra.

· Experience with developing, implementing, and configuring complex IT Security solutions.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Security concepts and principles (e.g. knowledge of SAML and OAuth).

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash, etc.).

· Networking technologies and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls).

· Virtualisation, Citrix, VMware.

· Cloud computing – AWS, Azure, Google, and hybrid environments.

· Windows Server/Active Directory/ADFS

· Linux (Red hat and/or SUSE), IOS, Android.


We are a focused team with highly experienced staff, a great offering, and you will be part of a growing team with a fun and positive culture. Whatever your goals, there will be plenty of room for career advancement as we grow. Remuneration will be commensurate with skills and experience. If this is the opportunity you have been waiting for, then we want to hear from you! Your resume will be assessed by our team, and if we feel that you could be a good fit, we will be in touch regarding the next steps.

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
